People: Mungo Park (author, Wikidata Q219086), died 1806; John Whishaw (editor, Wikidata Q15994828), died 1840. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Park, Mungo, 1771-1806; Whishaw, J. (John), 1765?-1840 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Journal of a Mission to the Interior of Africa, in the year 1805, John Murray (London), 1815, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/india.history.resource.18142. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 79%, 63%, 84% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of John Whishaw, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
